intended_object: The canonical linear map A'/A → V/(A + B) induced by the inclusion A' ⊆ V, for subspaces A ≤ A' and B of a K-vector space V; it is used in the Čech proof of Riemann's inequality (from the docstring and module documentation).
explanation: The source is A' ⧸ (A.comap A'.subtype), i.e. A'/(A ∩ A'), which equals A'/A when A ≤ A' (the hypothesis in every theorem of the file). The map is Submodule.mapQ applied to the inclusion A'.subtype. Its well-definedness condition, that the inclusion sends A ∩ A' into A ⊔ B, follows from A ≤ A ⊔ B (comap_mono le_sup_left). So the map sends [x] to [x], exactly the canonical map described. It could be stated over any ring, but the file's purpose (finrank and rank–nullity) needs a field, so the Field setting is appropriate. Mathlib has no dedicated declaration for this specific map; it is built directly from the general Submodule.mapQ.
